Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. According to Civiqs, the Republican president holds a strong approval rating in Oklahoma among several demographics, including all poll takers 35 and older, postgraduate-educated individuals, non-Republicans and non-white people.

Oklahoma's party lines mimic that of the national level. Oklahoma Democrats disapprove of Trump at the same rate as the nation; however, Oklahoma Republicans favor him more, at 83%, and Oklahoma Independents disapprove more, 66%. [...] After political affiliation, the next highest disapproval is found among Black poll takers, at 79%.
